$schema_comment: Hand-maintained source of truth for every Glassmkr alert rule ID. Read by scripts/validate-rule-ids.mjs in CI. When you add or remove a rule, edit this file FIRST, then update either: (a) Crucible's src/alerts/rules.ts + rule-ids.json (collector or both), or (b) Forge's evaluator.ts (forge), or (c) Forge's watchdog.ts (forge). The validator now cross-checks all three sources. Customer-facing rule count = manifest length; see RULES_COUNT.md.

rules.notes: Cycle-2 campaign 2026-05-20. PSI io.full companion to cpu_iowait_high; catches the modern-NVMe case where iowait stays near zero but PSI sees brief CPU stalls. Threshold avg10 > 10% + corroborator (slow device latency / IO errors / iowait >= 5%). Subordinate to cpu_iowait_high. validation-pending.
Renamed from collector-side swap_active in Crucible 0.8.0; aligned to Forge name.

Monitoring blind spot, not a drive fault (Crucible 0.14.4+ snap.smart_unreadable): fixed disks present in /sys/block whose SMART smartctl could not read (smartmontools missing, or an unsupported controller needing a -d type). Without it a host with unreadable disks looks diskless and a real failure goes unmonitored (bit us on val-hdd-destroy-1). P2 warning ceiling, never pages, ack-able. Crucible suppresses the marker on healthy HW-RAID boxes (the controller's own VD), so it does not fire there.
Was dead in collector before 0.8.0 (read wrong field). Fixed to read snap.io_latency.
Collector now reads /sys/class/hwmon as primary, IPMI fallback.
Collector merges named-sensor + SEL counts (Dell exposes only via SEL).
Collector vendor-aware: Dell PS Redundancy aggregate + per-PSU.

Dashboard evaluator; fires when the BMC SEL is full or near-full (a log-full / logging-disabled Asserted event, or sel_entries_count >= 3000 near-full heuristic). A full SEL stops recording new events, so ipmi_sel_critical goes structurally deaf to every future hardware fault. A cleared SEL auto-resolves on the next snapshot. Val campaign box asrock, 2026-07-14.

Dashboard evaluator; fires when snap.ipmi.detection reports available:false for any reason EXCEPT no_bmc_device. A host with a BMC whose IPMI probe is refused or failing has no fan, PSU, SEL, or IPMI-ECC monitoring at all, so ipmi_fan_failure / psu_redundancy_loss / ipmi_sel_critical / ipmi_sel_full are all structurally deaf while the host reads green. Same blind-spot class as ipmi_sel_full. Observed live on 3 of 20 fleet hosts, all reason ipmitool_cve_2020_5208 (ipmitool 1.8.18 < 1.8.19). Added 2026-07-29 from the DataPacket fit study gap P1-2.
Dashboard evaluator reads snap.ipmi VBAT/CMOS sensors; fires < 2.6V (CR2032 replacement). Missing half of PR #229's psu_rail VBAT exclusion. Added 2026-05-26 (PR #237).
Config-vs-runtime false-negative guard from the blind-remediation campaign. Collector side shipped in Crucible 0.13.16 (crucible#49). Added 2026-07-03 (PR #467).

CRITICAL. From the val-rocky boot-failure postmortem (2026-08-30): the NEXT-boot entry's root=UUID/LABEL resolves to no present filesystem, so the next reboot drops to the dracut emergency shell. Crucible 1.2.0+ snap.boot_config.default_entry_bootable===false. Capability-gated (available:true); proven silent on the four val distros. Warns in the window before the fatal reboot; no boot-grace.

WARNING. Boots today, but the kernel-cmdline source, the default entry, or a fallback entry points at a wrong/absent filesystem, so a future kernel update or fallback boot could strand the host (val-rocky failure mode). Crucible 1.2.0+ snap.boot_config source_regressed / default_entry_wrong_fs / unbootable_entry_count. Ack-able.

Watchdog rule (apps/dashboard/src/lib/server/watchdog.ts), not an evaluator rule. Fires when a server stops reporting snapshots. Missed in the original Phase 1 audit; added 2026-05-06 as part of canonical-count alignment.
PSI classifier (Crucible C2). Parent for cpu_high + load_high. Capability-gated on snap.psi.cpu (v0.10.4+).
PSI memory pressure with pswpin corroboration (C2 + C3). Subordinate to oom_kills.
Uncorrected machine check exception from EDAC (C1). P0; incident-group memory_hardware_fault with ecc_errors.

DIMM topology Tier 1 (CC_SPEC_DIMM_POPULATION_2026-07-04): empty memory channels or rank/2DPC downclock from SMBIOS Type 17 (snap.memory_topology, Crucible 0.13.19+). P3 advisory; ack when the population is an intentional capacity/cost tradeoff.

Currency-monitoring milestone 2026-07-15. Two-field advisory: release EOL date from the synced endoflife.date dataset (os_lifecycle table + in-memory cache) combined with the host's extended-support enrollment (snap.support_status, Crucible 0.13.24+ support-status collector). Warning ceiling (never pages). Degrades to conservative 'enrollment not verified' wording when the support signal is absent, so it never falsely claims a host is unsupported. Approaching-EOL is info; past standard support unenrolled/unknown is warning.

Currency-monitoring milestone 2026-07-15. INFO-only advisory (never a fault): fires when snap.dmi.bios_date is older than 24 months on bare metal (VM/placeholder dates guarded). Raw BIOS age is not a should-update signal; the wording nudges verification against the vendor catalog. Both deep-research passes flagged BIOS age as unsound as an action alert, so it ships info-only pending a real update-availability source (fwupd/Redfish).
ZIL log vdev FAULTED or REMOVED (C6). Capability-gated on snap.zfs.pools[].slog_vdevs[].
Linear projection on per-mount available_bytes (cross-snapshot library Phase 3). P1 < 24h-to-full; P2 < 7d. Companion to disk_space_high (absolute %).

Classifier: fires when 2+ of conntrack_exhaustion / listen_overflow / tcp_retrans_high are active on same host within 5 min. All three subordinates now ship (2026-05-19 C7-C10 activation); classifier active.
C8 (Crucible v0.11.0). MII up but LACP partner unsynchronized; also emits warning on aggregator port shortfall. Subordinate to bond_slave_down.
C10 (Crucible v0.11.0). Retransmit ratio > 2% over snapshot interval. Subordinate to bond_slave_down; participates in accept_backlog_or_syn_flood.
C10 (Crucible v0.11.0). /proc/net/netstat ListenOverflows/ListenDrops non-zero rate. Subordinate to bond_slave_down; participates in accept_backlog_or_syn_flood.
C12 (Crucible v0.12.0). systemctl show Result=oom-kill. Subordinate to oom_kills.
C12 (Crucible v0.12.0). start-limit-hit OR NRestarts>=5; via failed_unit_details.
C14 (Crucible v0.12.0). metadata_percent >= 80% warn / 95% critical. Silent + catastrophic when full.
C17 (Crucible v0.12.0). Non-zero Critical Warning byte per NVMe spec §5.21. Always critical.
C16 (Crucible v0.12.0). /proc/net/softnet_stat input_queue_dropped rate >1/s warn, >10/s critical.
C19 (Crucible v0.13.0). NVIDIA XID critical events per published severity table. P0. validation-pending.
C19. Uncorrected VRAM ECC or DBE retired pages. P0. validation-pending.
C19. GPU die temp >= 90C or thermal slowdown engaged. P1. validation-pending.
C19. NVLink down on multi-GPU host. Tier 1 + Tier 2 enrichment (Tier 2 ships as stub in v0.13.0). P1. validation-pending. (Distinct from rule audit's lacp_partner_lost which is bonding/Ethernet.)
C19. GPU PCIe gen/width below advertised max. P2. validation-pending.
C19. sw_power_cap or hw_power_brake throttle reason engaged. P2. validation-pending.

Fleet report rec #1: NVIDIA GPU present but the nvidia module is not loaded or nouveau is not blacklisted; the GPU will not survive a reboot (nouveau binds first, a Vast host de-lists). P1; critical when the driver is already down. Dashboard rule over Crucible driver_resilience.
C19. Within-host vbios drift across multiple GPUs of the same model. P3 info. validation-pending. Cross-host fleet drift deferred.
C19. Corrected-ECC volatile counter > 1000 OR retired_pages_single_bit > 0. P3 info. Per-snapshot level signal; cross-snapshot rate calc deferred. validation-pending.
